purpose: phase 4 capacity decision; estimates are not full-run measurements

hardware.historical_windows_inventory: manifests/hardware.json; not the current run machine

limitations: encoding is extrapolated from warmed source-only samples, not a completed full build
thermal slowdown and variation in padded batch lengths can change actual runtime
index payload estimate excludes manifests and filesystem overhead
compute estimate excludes model/index loading, serialization, persistence, online work and analysis
raw-log and heap estimates use a smaller-corpus diagnostic; full records can differ
preflight peak RSS does not measure the complete runner with accumulated history

planning_allowances.enforcement: planning allowances only; no automatic timeout or memory cap
planning_allowances.overrun_policy: preserve records and reassess; do not reduce sample or alter algorithms mid-run

scope.source_corpora: complete prepared corpora from declared SQuAD source and pinned HotpotQA mirror
scope.held_out_use: evaluation only after a complete development run and selection freeze

commands.preflight: DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PWD/.venv/lib/python3.14/site-packages/torch/lib PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m ragbench_lab.feasibility configs/stage-a-study.toml --squad-dir data/prepared/squad-study-v1 --hotpot-dir data/prepared/hotpot-study-v1 --output artifacts/stage-a-preflight-v1
commands.development_planned: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m ragbench_lab stage-a-run configs/stage-a-study.toml --squad-dir data/prepared/squad-study-v1 --hotpot-dir data/prepared/hotpot-study-v1 --index-root indexes/stage-a-study-v1 --output runs/stage-a-development-v1
commands.selection_planned: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m ragbench_lab stage-a-select --run-dir runs/stage-a-development-v1 --output reports/stage-a-selection-v1.json --freeze manifests/stage-a-selection-v1.json
commands.evaluation_planned: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m ragbench_lab stage-a-run configs/stage-a-study.toml --squad-dir data/prepared/squad-study-v1 --hotpot-dir data/prepared/hotpot-study-v1 --index-root indexes/stage-a-study-v1 --output runs/stage-a-evaluation-v1 --split evaluation --freeze manifests/stage-a-selection-v1.json

resume_policy: same command plus --resume; no configuration, source or environment changes
scientific_limitation: HotpotQA mirror official-byte equivalence remains unverified
